summary: Peabody Energy filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, reporting the pricing and closing of a $250 million private offering of 0.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031. Net proceeds of ~$243.3 million will be used to fund capped call transactions (~$16.7M) and, with available cash, repurchase ~$241.2M of its outstanding 3.250% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 for ~$388.8M total cash. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, convertible only under specified stock price conditions or upon certain corporate events. The filing describes a refinancing of existing convertible debt, not a special situation acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. Routine capital management.
